Features

Clear Pictures & Sound For Larger Meeting Rooms

Remote participants can see and hear everyone in the room clearly, even in larger spaces.

200MP Quad Camera System

Four 50MP cameras with 1/1.55 inch sensors capture the room at up to 3840 × 2160.

Wide & Telephoto Lenses

The wide lens covers 125° horizontally, and the telephoto lenses give close-up shots with 8x hybrid zoom.

AI Framing & Tracking

Auto framing, speaker tracking, smart gathering and intelligent focus adjust the shot as people speak.

16-Mic Array Pickup

Up to four expansion microphones can be added to the 16-mic array, which picks up voices at up to 10m.

Noise & Echo Control

Noise reduction, echo cancellation, anti-reverberation and an audio fence help remote callers hear speech clearly.

Dual 20W Stereo Speakers

Two full-frequency speakers with four passive radiators play call audio across the room.

Overview

Meetings Start at the Table

Windows 11 IoT Enterprise SAC and Microsoft Teams Rooms run on an Intel Core i5-1240P inside the bar. People start and control calls on the TCP31T console, which wakes when its motion sensor detects someone nearby.

  • Wired sharing over HDMI reaches up to 4K at 30fps.
  • A USB-C cable to the console shares a laptop screen at 1080p.
  • Three HDMI outputs support 4K at 60Hz with CEC control.
  • An automatic electric shutter covers the camera lenses for privacy.
  • MAXHUB Pivot monitors device status remotely over the internet.
What's in the Kit

Bar & Console, Packed With Their Own Cables

The XBar W70 comes paired with a TCP31T touch console. Each unit ships with its own cables.

XBar W70 Video Bar

The 840.6mm bar holds the cameras, microphones, speakers and room PC, and weighs 5kg.

In its box
  • Power adapter and 1.5m AC cable
  • Two 3m HDMI cables
  • One 3m and one 7.5m Ethernet cable
  • Mounting components

TCP31T Touch Console

An 11.6 inch capacitive screen with an anti-glare, anti-fingerprint surface controls each meeting.

In its box
  • 1.8m USB-C cable
  • 7.5m Ethernet cable
  • Screwdriver

Optional Add-Ons

A WT13M or WT13S wireless dongle and the TCP30WM wall-mount bracket for the console are available as optional extras.

FAQs

Common Questions on XBar W70 Kit

01What does the XBar W70 Kit include?

The kit contains the XBar W70 video bar and the TCP31T touch console. The bar comes with a power adapter, an AC cable, two 3m HDMI cables, a 3m and a 7.5m Ethernet cable and mounting components. The console comes with a 1.8m USB-C cable, a 7.5m Ethernet cable and a screwdriver.

02Which operating system does it run?

Windows 11 IoT Enterprise SAC runs on the bar’s Intel Core i5-1240P with 16GB of memory and 256GB of storage. Microsoft Teams Rooms is the meeting application.

03What room sizes is it suited to?

It suits medium to large meeting rooms. The 16-mic array picks up voices at up to 10m, and the wide camera covers 125° horizontally.

04How can presenters share content?

Content shared in a Teams meeting runs at 1080p and 30fps. For local sharing, the HDMI input supports 4K at 30fps and the console’s USB-C port supports 1080p at 30fps.

05Can a laptop use the kit for BYOD meetings?

Yes. In BYOD mode, a laptop connects to the kit with a single USB cable.

06Can more microphones be added?

Up to four expansion microphones are supported. The RJ45 Ext port connects MAXHUB accessories, such as microphones and cameras.

07Do the cameras follow the person speaking?

Yes. Speaker tracking moves the shot to the active speaker, and auto framing, smart gathering and intelligent focus adjust the view of the group. An automatic electric shutter covers the lenses for privacy.

08Can the touch console be wall mounted?

It can, with the optional TCP30WM wall-mount bracket. The console also has a PIR motion sensor that wakes it when someone approaches.
